_about: Ralph Barton Perry (1876-1957), American new realist, the books published by 1930 that Gutenberg has: The Approach to Philosophy (New York: Scribner, 1905) and The Moral Economy (Scribner, 1909), clean Gutenberg texts. Not T. S. Perry (ts-perry shelf). Added in round ab: Present Philosophical Tendencies, with a synopsis of the philosophy of William James (New York: Longmans, Green; first published 1912, this a new impression of 1921). US public domain (published before 1931). Added in round cm from Internet Archive scans dated on their title pages: The Free Man and the Soldier (1916), The Present Conflict of Ideals (1918) and Philosophy of the Recent Past (1926). General Theory of Value (1926) stays wanted: an Internet Archive search found no scan. No uids minted.
